caption: The drawing depicts a wooden structure composed primarily of various geometric shapes with a reddish-brown hue. The base is a curved, rectangular block set on three spherical feet. Two vertically ribbed cylindrical columns support a flat horizontal plank, which has three golden-brown spherical finials (one on each end and one centered on top). Resting atop the plank, centrally aligned, is a large ring with a hollow circular center, also in a reddish-brown color, with the topmost finial perched on it. The background is a plain, light beige color. There is text at the bottom right that reads "William H. Edwards. Del. 3901."
title: Watch Holder
